newsitem.title: BRAZIL: British woman dies in Brazil in 39th-floor fall.
newsitem.headline: British woman dies in Brazil in 39th-floor fall.

text.p: A British woman is believed to have committed suicide by jumping from the 39th floor of the five-star Meridien Hotel in Rio de Janeiro, a police spokesman said on Thursday.
Katrina Dunleavy, 31, who was on a business trip carrying out a market research project for a consultancy firm, was found dead by hotel security guards early on Wednesday, he said.
"The investigation points toward suicide but we are waiting for the forensic and coroner's reports to close the case," the spokesman said.
The day before her death Dunleavy was removed by security guards from the 39th-floor terrace, which was off limits to hotel guests, a hotel spokeswoman said.
The terrace is an emergency exit and cannot be locked, but there is a sign in three languages telling hotel guests to stay away because it is dangerous.
Dunleavy's home town was not available.
